title: Shri Balaji Cricket Academy Website

requirements.text: Create a Hero section on the homepage featuring the academy name 'Shri Balaji Cricket Academy', a compelling tagline, and a call-to-action button encouraging parents to enroll their children.

quotes: MAKE A WEBSITE FOR A CRICKET ACADEMY NAMED SHRI BALAJI CRICKET ACADEMY

acceptanceCriteria: Academy name 'Shri Balaji Cricket Academy' is prominently displayed in the hero section
A tagline is visible below the academy name
A call-to-action button (e.g., 'Enroll Now' or 'Get Started') is present and scrolls to the contact/enquiry form

requirements.text: Create an 'About Us' section describing the academy's mission, coaching philosophy, and commitment to nurturing young cricket talent.

quotes: MAKE A WEBSITE FOR A CRICKET ACADEMY

acceptanceCriteria: About Us section is present on the page
Section includes text about the academy's mission and coaching philosophy
Section is visually distinct and easy to read

requirements.text: Create a 'Coaching Programs' section that highlights the available programs, clearly stating the minimum age requirement of 7 years for enrollment, along with program benefits and features.

quotes: WE COACH CHILDREN ABOVE AGE 7 YEARS

acceptanceCriteria: Coaching Programs section is present on the page
Minimum age of 7 years is explicitly mentioned
Program cards or list items display key features and benefits
Section is clearly organized and easy to scan

requirements.text: Create a Gallery section displaying a grid of cricket academy activity images (use generated placeholder images) to showcase training sessions, matches, and academy life.
acceptanceCriteria: Gallery section is present on the page
Images are displayed in a responsive grid layout
Section has a clear heading such as 'Gallery' or 'Our Academy in Action'

requirements.text: Create a Contact/Enquiry section with a form allowing parents to submit their child's name, parent's name, phone number, child's age, and a message. Store submitted enquiries in the backend.

quotes: WE COACH CHILDREN ABOVE AGE 7 YEARS

acceptanceCriteria: Contact form includes fields: child's name, parent's name, phone number, child's age, and message
Form validates that the child's age is 7 or above
On submission, the enquiry data is saved in the backend
A success confirmation message is shown after successful submission
Academy contact details (phone, address placeholder) are shown alongside the form

requirements.text: Create a sticky navigation bar with links to all page sections (Home, About, Programs, Gallery, Contact) and the academy logo/name. Navigation should be smooth-scrolling.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigation bar is sticky and visible on scroll
All section links are present and scroll smoothly to their respective sections
Academy name or logo is displayed in the navbar
Navigation is responsive and collapses appropriately on mobile screens

requirements.text: Apply a bold cricket-themed visual design with a deep green and gold color palette, strong serif/display typography for headings, and a clean, energetic layout evoking a professional sports academy. Enforce this theme consistently across all sections.
acceptanceCriteria: Deep green and gold are the dominant brand colors used throughout the site
Headings use a strong, prominent typography style
Visual theme is consistent across all sections
Overall design feels professional and suitable for a sports coaching academy

constraints: Academy name must always appear as 'Shri Balaji Cricket Academy' exactly
Minimum enrollment age of 7 years must be clearly communicated wherever programs are mentioned
nonGoals: Online payment or fee collection functionality
User authentication or parent/student login portal
Live match scores or cricket news feed integration
